{{Short description|Study of a group of individuals taken from the general population}}
{{one source |date=April 2024}}
'''Population study''' is an [[Interdisciplinarity|interdisciplinary field]] of [[Scientific studies|scientific study]] that uses various [[statistical methods]] and models to analyse, determine, address, and predict population challenges and trends from data collected through various [[data collection]] methods such as [[Census|population census]], registration method, [[Sampling (statistics)|sampling]], and some other systems of data sources.<ref>{{Cite book |last=Mittal |first=Rakhi |url=http://162.241.27.72/siteAdmin/dde-admin/uploads/1/PG_M.A._Socialogy_M.A.%20(Sociology)%20-%20351%2013%20-%20Population%20Studies.pdf |title=Population Studies |publisher=VIKAS® PUBLISHING HOUSE PVT. LTD. |year=2018 |location=New Delhi |pages=25 |language=en}}</ref> In the various fields of healthcare, a '''population study''' is a study of a group of individuals taken from the general [[Population (human biology)|population]] who share a common characteristic, such as age, [[Biological sex|sex]], or health condition. This group may be studied for different reasons, such as their [[Drug trial|response to a drug]] or [[Relative rate test|risk of getting a disease]].{{citation needed|date=May 2023}}
